title: Necromancer: The Fallen Serve | RTS Base-Builder | Solo dev demo now live
author: anti-govv
selftext:
Been working on **Necromancer: The Fallen Serve** solo for about 9 months now, using AI throughout development for optimizations(Managed to get a flawless 300 summons + enemy AI smooth, achieved by splitting frames handling different loads), debugging, iteration and helping me tackle systems that would normally be pretty ambitious for one developer.

It’s a dark fantasy RTS inspired by necromancer manhwa like **Disastrous Necromancer**, where enemies you kill become resources for your next army. You raise skeletons, collect bones and souls, build your base and keep growing the undead army.

The demo has the opening campaign section where you start at full power, plus an endless Horde Mode.

Full game will have more summon unlocks and several different factions/races to conquer.

The demo is finally live, so I’d love feedback from anyone here - especially other solo devs using AI to take on projects that would normally be way too large.

**Free demo:**
